caption: The drawing features a single object positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background with some visible texture and subtle discoloration. The object has a smooth, dark brown hue and a glossy appearance, consisting of two distinct sections joined at an angle. The upper section is elongated, slightly curved, and tapers at the ends, resembling a handle with rounded ends. The lower section is thinner, straight, and attaches perpendicularly to the upper part, terminating in a hook-like, curved tip with a bulbous end. There is a handwritten inscription in the bottom right corner that reads "M.H. B. Tenso - 40." No additional objects or elements are present in the composition.
title: Dental Forceps
